description: dirk_lib library-level settings. Controls global theming, localization, and other shared defaults used by every resource that depends on dirk_lib.

appearance.description: Global UI theme and branding shared across every dirk_lib-powered NUI.

primaryColor.description: Mantine palette key used as the UI primary colour. Use 'dirk' to apply the custom palette defined below.

primaryShade.description: Mantine shade index (0 lightest, 9 darkest) picked from the primary palette for buttons, borders, and accents.

customTheme.description: Ten-colour palette (light to dark) used when primaryColor is set to 'dirk'. Provide exactly ten hex codes ordered from lightest shade to darkest.

localization.description: Language and currency defaults used by every dirk_lib consumer.

language.description: Locale code used when resolving strings from /locales.

currency.description: Currency symbol prefixed to money values rendered by dirk_lib UIs.

bridging.description: Pick which third-party resource (framework, inventory, target, etc.) and which UI library dirk_lib should bridge to. Resource bridges default to 'auto' so dirk_lib detects whatever's installed; UI bridges default to 'ox_lib' so servers running ox get its native UI without any extra setup. Set any value explicitly to override autodetect.

framework.description: Server framework dirk_lib reads player data from.

inventory.description: Inventory system used for item lookups, give/remove, and image paths.

interact.description: Interact-prompt system used as the alternative to target-based interactions.

phone.description: Phone resource (used for messages, mail, etc.).

branding.description: Server identity strings shown across dirk_lib-powered UIs.

serverName.description: Server branding string displayed in NUIs that surface a server name.

itemImgPath.description: Inventory image path used by dirk_lib UIs. 'auto' resolves from the detected inventory; override with a full nui://… or CDN URL.

groups.description: Defaults for the dirk_groups system (party invites, max members, log-off kicks).

maxDistanceInvite.description: Max metres between players for an invite to land.

inviteValidTime.description: Minutes an outstanding invite stays valid before expiring.

maxLogOffTime.description: Minutes a player can stay offline before being auto-kicked from their group.

scriptConfig.description: Per-resource access control for /dirk_config. The master group is configured via the `dirk_lib_master_group` server convar (defaults to `group.admin`) and can always edit any registered scriptConfig. Use `overrides` to grant additional access to specific resources for non-master ACE groups or specific player identifiers — purely additive, you cannot remove access from the master.

overrides.description: Per-resource extra access grants. Each entry lets the listed ACE groups or player identifiers edit that resource's scriptConfig in addition to the master. NOTE: no x-arrayKey here — this is a purely user-managed list with no schema defaults, so the smartMerge plain-array path (DB as source of truth) is correct. Adding x-arrayKey would make smartMerge iterate the empty defaults array and prune every DB entry on load.

groups.description: ACE permissions checked via IsPlayerAceAllowed (e.g. group.mod, dirkscripts.command.druglabs).

identifiers.description: Player identifiers (license:..., steam:..., discord:..., etc.) granted edit access regardless of group membership.

advanced.description: Low-level knobs most servers should leave alone.

primaryIdentifier.description: Which player identifier dirk_lib uses as the primary lookup key. Default 'license' works for the vast majority of servers — only change if your framework or txAdmin setup uses a different identifier.
